column1: # Expected values produced by pytrec_eval, the library BEIR evaluates
# with. Frozen CI regression fixture (ADR-10) — see regenerate.py, and
# do not edit a value by hand.
# k <TAB> run <TAB> qrels <TAB> ndcg_cut_k <TAB> recall_k <TAB> P_k <TAB> map_cut_k <TAB> recip_rank
# run   = doc ids best-first, comma separated, possibly empty
# qrels = id:grade pairs, comma separated; a grade of 0 means judged
#         and not relevant, which is not the same as absent
# recip_rank is uncut, matching trec_eval; the crate's cut variant
# reciprocal_rank_at_k has no trec_eval counterpart to compare to.
# the unit-test ranking
# cut below the number of relevant docs
# perfect ranking scores 1.0
# perfect top-k with k < R (the MAP@k divisor)
# perfect top-1 with k < R
# k far past the ranking length
# short run, precision still divides by k
# first relevant doc at rank 3
# judged-but-irrelevant doc is not a hit
# no relevant document retrieved
# empty run
# qrels judged, nothing relevant
# graded-only qrels, no grade-1 document
